description:
The Sugar Hill Gang scored the first and most popular Hip Hop single of all time in 1979 with “Rappers Delight”. Rappers Delight revolutionized the music industry by introducing a new art form of music throughout the world. It single-handedly influenced and inspired the Rap and Hip-Hop movements, opening the doors to one of the most powerful and popular styles of popular music EVER.
Global music legends, multi-platinum selling artists, Grammy Hall of Fame, and Walk of Fame inductees and one of the most successful – iconic music acts of all time. The Sugar Hill Gang has been at the forefront of some of the most ground-breaking trends and movements in modern pop culture. The group has been a trendsetter in music, dance, and fashion.

The Sugar Hill Gang will be performing hits from across their expansive and impressive career, which have sold more than 20 million records worldwide. They have tallied millions of streams and sales worldwide and forever changed the history of music making Hip Hop the biggest music genre in the world!





Standing Tickets:  £30 (+booking fee)
Dinner & Show Ticket: £80 Balcony Dining or £70 non-balcony (both include a Three Course Meal & ticket) – please click on the ‘make a booking enquiry‘ button at the bottom.
Doors open at 6pm

The Jam House, Birmingham – Where music entertainment lives since 1999…  Nestled in the heart of Birmingham’s historic Jewellery Quarter, The Jam House is a renowned live music venue set within a beautiful Georgian building overlooking the scenic St Paul’s Square. This award-winning destination combines live entertainment, delicious food, and unforgettable nights out, making it a must-visit spot for locals and tourists alike.

Getting Here:🚗 Free Parking: Available around St Paul’s Square after 6 PM.🚆 Nearest Train Station: Snow Hill Station – just a short walk away.🚋 Nearest Tram Stop: St Paul’s – conveniently located nearby
Contact: birmingham@thejamhouse.com | 0121 200 3030 |

description:
Step inside the JQ Jazz House, where an authentic New Orleans brass band brings the spirit of Mardi Gras straight to Birmingham. 

From high‑energy parade rhythms to soulful street‑corner grooves, the band delivers classic NOLA favourites alongside bold, creative twists on the songs you love—spanning Funk, Jazz, Pop, and RnB.
With a mix of carefully chosen classics and spontaneous improvisation, this feel-good live music performance transports you to the NOLA roots of this genre with a contemporary twist. Get your tickets now for the JQ Jazz House!

Highlights🎵 Enjoy a live music performance from talented group of jazz musicians✈️ Be transported to the spirit of the New Orleans Mardi Gras🎺 Listen to the soulful sounds of a variety of brass instruments🤩 Enjoy a mix of NOLA Mardi Gras tunes and improvisation of pop covers in a jazz fashion🍷 Perfect for a date night or sophisticated fun



General Info
🎟️ Tickets: available on Ticket Master
📅 Show Time: 7pm (Doors open at 6pm)
⏳ Show Duration: 2 x 45 mins sets (with a short interval in-between sets)
🍴 Food:  Two Course Meal & ticket £45 – please click on the ‘make a booking enquiry‘ button at the bottom.
👤 Age requirement: 18+🪑 Please note: some tables are shared and seating is assigned on a first-come basis.

ProgrammeNOLA Mardi Gras, Jazz, Funk, Pop & RnB.

DescriptionSet within an award‑winning live music venue in the heart of the Jewellery Quarter, The JQ Jazz House transports you back to the birthplace of America’s most iconic musical tradition. Sip a cocktail from the bar as the stage comes alive with rich brass harmonies, infectious rhythms, and spontaneous improvisation—the beating heart of true New Orleans jazz.
Be part of the magic. Be part of the legacy.

Get your tickets now for The JQ Jazz House: Transporting you to the Spirit of New Orleans here in Birmingham!
The Jam House, Birmingham – Where music entertainment lives since 1999…  Nestled in the heart of Birmingham’s historic Jewellery Quarter, The Jam House is a renowned live music venue set within a beautiful Georgian building overlooking the scenic St Paul’s Square. This award-winning destination combines live entertainment, delicious food, and unforgettable nights out, making it a must-visit spot for locals and tourists alike.

Getting Here:🚗 Free Parking: Available around St Paul’s Square after 6 PM.🚆 Nearest Train Station: Snow Hill Station – just a short walk away.🚋 Nearest Tram Stop: St Paul’s – conveniently located nearby

description:
Uncover Music presents

ACUA

ACUA is a psych-pop/alternative band from Cologne.

After over 100 concerts and successful tours across Europe, Canada, the UK and Japan, as well as the release of two studio albums, Head Under Water and Is There More Past Or More Future, ACUA is currently preparing the release of their third album.

Patrick (vocals, guitar), Caroline (drums), Maja (synthesizer), and Igor (bass) have built a remarkable reputation through their captivating, hypnotic live shows.

With atmospheric guitars, driving drums, swirling synthesizers, and melodic basslines, ACUA has shared the stage as support act for artists such as FKJ, Darwin Deez, The Japanese House, Sam Evian, and OMNI. They have also performed at prominent festivals like Melt! Festival, Reeperbahn Festival, Canadian Music Week and Herzberg Festival.

This fall they will release a new album and the first singles of it called "Now And Nothing" and "Fearing And Facing The World" were just released, giving a taste of what's to come.

"If you put your head under water, everything gets quiet and you can hear nothing but yourself."

description:
Step into the Arena!
For the first time ever, GladFans across the UK will be able to put their speed, strength and skills to the ultimate test, as the iconic television show explodes into action with Gladiators Experience!
Do you have the nerve to traverse the Hang Tough course? Could you be the last person standing in an epic bout of Duel? Would staring up at The Wall inspire you to scale new heights? ALL SINGING ALL DANCING FRIDAYS is a night of fantastic food & drinks deals and Tremendous Live Entertainment!
Tonight the featured band is UP4 the DOWNSTROKE. Stellar vocal harmony is blended with excellent musicianship to make Downstroke the UKs premier band, igniting the stage with a TOTALLY LIVE performance of faves from Beyoncé, Next, Rihanna, Grace Jones, The Pointer sisters and many more.
Your Host for the Night: DJ Pete SherriffSpinning a mix of classic and contemporary tracks and videos, DJ Pete Sherriff sets the tone and introduces our first live act at 9pm — a boogie-woogie performance by our resident piano & drum duo.
Doors Open at 6pm🍸2-4-1 Cocktails all night long!
Admission:

Free before 8pm
£5 before 10pm
£8 After

Advance Tickets £5 - Main Band starts around 11pm, piano and drums duo on from 9.30pm.
Book a Dinner & Show ticket in our Restaurant:To reserve a table for an unforgettable evening of dining and live entertainment, click the Booking Enquiry button below or give us a call on 0121 200 3030.
Dietary needs? Notify us at booking (vegan, gluten-free, nut allergies). Menus subject to seasonal changes.
The Jam House, Birmingham – Where music entertainment lives since 1999…  Nestled in the heart of Birmingham’s historic Jewellery Quarter, The Jam House is a renowned live music venue set within a beautiful Georgian building overlooking the scenic St Paul’s Square. This award-winning destination combines live entertainment, delicious food, and unforgettable nights out, making it a must-visit spot for locals and tourists alike.
Getting Here:🚗 Free Parking: Available around St Paul’s Square after 6 PM or NCP Jewellery Quarter🚆 Nearest Train Station: Snow Hill Station – just a short walk away.🚋 Nearest Tram Stop: St Paul’s – conveniently located nearby
Contact: birmingham@thejamhouse.com | 0121 200 3030 |

description:
Step into the Arena!
For the first time ever, GladFans across the UK will be able to put their speed, strength and skills to the ultimate test, as the iconic television show explodes into action with Gladiators Experience!
Do you have the nerve to traverse the Hang Tough course? Could you be the last person standing in an epic bout of Duel? Would staring up at The Wall inspire you to scale new heights? Will you be swinging to victory at the end of the legendary Eliminator? Taking place at the Birmingham NEC from May 2026, aspiring Contenders can at long last test their mettle in their favourite events!
And the action doesn’t end there! Away from the Arena, Gladiators Experience boasts even more fun, family-friendly attractions. There’s The Vault, which delivers an unmissable look behind the scenes of the nation’s favourite TV show. The Gladiator Training Facility, meanwhile, will sharpen the skillset needed to be a true Gladiator, and a huge Superstore will be the only place to purchase exclusive merchandise. Plus, with many other surprises along the way, Gladiators Experience is a spectacle like no other.
So whether you’re strapping on your helmet and dusting off your gumshield, or simply celebrating your love of the legendary, culture-defining television show, Gladiators Experience is an unmissable opportunity to live out your Gladiator dreams!

description:
Step into the Arena!
For the first time ever, GladFans across the UK will be able to put their speed, strength and skills to the ultimate test, as the iconic television show explodes into action with Gladiators Experience!
Do you have the nerve to traverse the Hang Tough course? Could you be the last person standing in an epic bout of Duel? Would staring up at The Wall inspire you to scale new heights? Will you be swinging to victory at the end of the legendary Eliminator? Taking place at the Birmingham NEC from May 2026, aspiring Contenders can at long last test their mettle in their favourite events!
And the action doesn’t end there! Away from the Arena, Gladiators Experience boasts even more fun, family-friendly attractions. There’s The Vault, which delivers an unmissable look behind the scenes of the nation’s favourite TV show. The Gladiator Training Facility, meanwhile, will sharpen the skillset needed to be a true Gladiator, and a huge Superstore will be the only place to purchase exclusive merchandise. Plus, with many other surprises along the way, Gladiators Experience is a spectacle like no other.
So whether you’re strapping on your helmet and dusting off your gumshield, or simply celebrating your love of the legendary, culture-defining television show, Gladiators Experience is an unmissable opportunity to live out your Gladiator dreams!

description:
Step into the Arena!
For the first time ever, GladFans across the UK will be able to put their speed, strength and skills to the ultimate test, as the iconic television show explodes into action with Gladiators Experience!
Do you have the nerve to traverse the Hang Tough course? Could you be the last person standing in an epic bout of Duel? Would staring up at The Wall inspire you to scale new heights? Will you be swinging to victory at the end of the legendary Eliminator? Taking place at the Birmingham NEC from May 2026, aspiring Contenders can at long last test their mettle in their favourite events!
And the action doesn’t end there! Away from the Arena, Gladiators Experience boasts even more fun, family-friendly attractions. There’s The Vault, which delivers an unmissable look behind the scenes of the nation’s favourite TV show. The Gladiator Training Facility, meanwhile, will sharpen the skillset needed to be a true Gladiator, and a huge Superstore will be the only place to purchase exclusive merchandise. Plus, with many other surprises along the way, Gladiators Experience is a spectacle like no other.
So whether you’re strapping on your helmet and dusting off your gumshield, or simply celebrating your love of the legendary, culture-defining television show, Gladiators Experience is an unmissable opportunity to live out your Gladiator dreams!

description:
Step into the Arena!
For the first time ever, GladFans across the UK will be able to put their speed, strength and skills to the ultimate test, as the iconic television show explodes into action with Gladiators Experience!
Do you have the nerve to traverse the Hang Tough course? Could you be the last person standing in an epic bout of Duel? Would staring up at The Wall inspire you to scale new heights? Will you be swinging to victory at the end of the legendary Eliminator? Taking place at the Birmingham NEC from May 2026, aspiring Contenders can at long last test their mettle in their favourite events!
And the action doesn’t end there! Away from the Arena, Gladiators Experience boasts even more fun, family-friendly attractions. There’s The Vault, which delivers an unmissable look behind the scenes of the nation’s favourite TV show. The Gladiator Training Facility, meanwhile, will sharpen the skillset needed to be a true Gladiator, and a huge Superstore will be the only place to purchase exclusive merchandise. Plus, with many other surprises along the way, Gladiators Experience is a spectacle like no other.
So whether you’re strapping on your helmet and dusting off your gumshield, or simply celebrating your love of the legendary, culture-defining television show, Gladiators Experience is an unmissable opportunity to live out your Gladiator dreams!

Plus, with many other surprises along the way, Gladiators Experience is a spectacle like no other.
So whether you’re strapping on your helmet and dusting off your gumshield, or simply celebrating your love of the legendary, culture-defining television show, Gladiators Experience is an unmissable opportunity to live out your Gladiator dreams!

description:
Step into the Arena!
For the first time ever, GladFans across the UK will be able to put their speed, strength and skills to the ultimate test, as the iconic television show explodes into action with Gladiators Experience!
Do you have the nerve to traverse the Hang Tough course? Could you be the last person standing in an epic bout of Duel? Would staring up at The Wall inspire you to scale new heights? Will you be swinging to victory at the end of the legendary Eliminator? Taking place at the Birmingham NEC from May 2026, aspiring Contenders can at long last test their mettle in their favourite events!
And the action doesn’t end there! Away from the Arena, Gladiators Experience boasts even more fun, family-friendly attractions. There’s The Vault, which delivers an unmissable look behind the scenes of the nation’s favourite TV show. The Gladiator Training Facility, meanwhile, will sharpen the skillset needed to be a true Gladiator, and a huge Superstore will be the only place to purchase exclusive merchandise. Plus, with many other surprises along the way, Gladiators Experience is a spectacle like no other.
So whether you’re strapping on your helmet and dusting off your gumshield, or simply celebrating your love of the legendary, culture-defining television show, Gladiators Experience is an unmissable opportunity to live out your Gladiator dreams!

description:
Step into the Arena!
For the first time ever, GladFans across the UK will be able to put their speed, strength and skills to the ultimate test, as the iconic television show explodes into action with Gladiators Experience!
Do you have the nerve to traverse the Hang Tough course? Could you be the last person standing in an epic bout of Duel? Would staring up at The Wall inspire you to scale new heights? Will you be swinging to victory at the end of the legendary Eliminator? Taking place at the Birmingham NEC from May 2026, aspiring Contenders can at long last test their mettle in their favourite events!
And the action doesn’t end there! Away from the Arena, Gladiators Experience boasts even more fun, family-friendly attractions. There’s The Vault, which delivers an unmissable look behind the scenes of the nation’s favourite TV show. The Gladiator Training Facility, meanwhile, will sharpen the skillset needed to be a true Gladiator, and a huge Superstore will be the only place to purchase exclusive merchandise. Plus, with many other surprises along the way, Gladiators Experience is a spectacle like no other.
So whether you’re strapping on your helmet and dusting off your gumshield, or simply celebrating your love of the legendary, culture-defining television show, Gladiators Experience is an unmissable opportunity to live out your Gladiator dreams!

description:
Step into the Arena!
For the first time ever, GladFans across the UK will be able to put their speed, strength and skills to the ultimate test, as the iconic television show explodes into action with Gladiators Experience!
Do you have the nerve to traverse the Hang Tough course? Could you be the last person standing in an epic bout of Duel? Would staring up at The Wall inspire you to scale new heights? Will you be swinging to victory at the end of the legendary Eliminator? Taking place at the Birmingham NEC from May 2026, aspiring Contenders can at long last test their mettle in their favourite events!
And the action doesn’t end there! Away from the Arena, Gladiators Experience boasts even more fun, family-friendly attractions. There’s The Vault, which delivers an unmissable look behind the scenes of the nation’s favourite TV show. The Gladiator Training Facility, meanwhile, will sharpen the skillset needed to be a true Gladiator, and a huge Superstore will be the only place to purchase exclusive merchandise. Plus, with many other surprises along the way, Gladiators Experience is a spectacle like no other.
So whether you’re strapping on your helmet and dusting off your gumshield, or simply celebrating your love of the legendary, culture-defining television show, Gladiators Experience is an unmissable opportunity to live out your Gladiator dreams!

description:
Step into the Arena!
For the first time ever, GladFans across the UK will be able to put their speed, strength and skills to the ultimate test, as the iconic television show explodes into action with Gladiators Experience!
Do you have the nerve to traverse the Hang Tough course? Could you be the last person standing in an epic bout of Duel? Would staring up at The Wall inspire you to scale new heights? Will you be swinging to victory at the end of the legendary Eliminator? Taking place at the Birmingham NEC from May 2026, aspiring Contenders can at long last test their mettle in their favourite events!
And the action doesn’t end there! Away from the Arena, Gladiators Experience boasts even more fun, family-friendly attractions. There’s The Vault, which delivers an unmissable look behind the scenes of the nation’s favourite TV show. The Gladiator Training Facility, meanwhile, will sharpen the skillset needed to be a true Gladiator, and a huge Superstore will be the only place to purchase exclusive merchandise. Plus, with many other surprises along the way, Gladiators Experience is a spectacle like no other.
So whether you’re strapping on your helmet and dusting off your gumshield, or simply celebrating your love of the legendary, culture-defining television show, Gladiators Experience is an unmissable opportunity to live out your Gladiator dreams!

Plus, with many other surprises along the way, Gladiators Experience is a spectacle like no other.
So whether you’re strapping on your helmet and dusting off your gumshield, or simply celebrating your love of the legendary, culture-defining television show, Gladiators Experience is an unmissable opportunity to live out your Gladiator dreams!

For the first time ever, GladFans across the UK will be able to put their speed, strength and skills to the ultimate test, as the iconic television show explodes into action with Gladiators Experience!
Do you have the nerve to traverse the Hang Tough course? Could you be the last person standing in an epic bout of Duel? Would staring up at The Wall inspire you to scale new heights? Will you be swinging to victory at the end of the legendary Eliminator? Taking place at the Birmingham NEC from May 2026, aspiring Contenders can at long last test their mettle in their favourite events!
And the action doesn’t end there! Away from the Arena, Gladiators Experience boasts even more fun, family-friendly attractions. There’s The Vault, which delivers an unmissable look behind the scenes of the nation’s favourite TV show. The Gladiator Training Facility, meanwhile, will sharpen the skillset needed to be a true Gladiator, and a huge Superstore will be the only place to purchase exclusive merchandise. Plus, with many other surprises along the way, Gladiators Experience is a spectacle like no other.
So whether you’re strapping on your helmet and dusting off your gumshield, or simply celebrating your love of the legendary, culture-defining television show, Gladiators Experience is an unmissable opportunity to live out your Gladiator dreams!

description:
Step into the Arena!
For the first time ever, GladFans across the UK will be able to put their speed, strength and skills to the ultimate test, as the iconic television show explodes into action with Gladiators Experience!
Do you have the nerve to traverse the Hang Tough course? Could you be the last person standing in an epic bout of Duel? Would staring up at The Wall inspire you to scale new heights? Will you be swinging to victory at the end of the legendary Eliminator? Taking place at the Birmingham NEC from May 2026, aspiring Contenders can at long last test their mettle in their favourite events!
And the action doesn’t end there! Away from the Arena, Gladiators Experience boasts even more fun, family-friendly attractions. There’s The Vault, which delivers an unmissable look behind the scenes of the nation’s favourite TV show. The Gladiator Training Facility, meanwhile, will sharpen the skillset needed to be a true Gladiator, and a huge Superstore will be the only place to purchase exclusive merchandise. Plus, with many other surprises along the way, Gladiators Experience is a spectacle like no other.
So whether you’re strapping on your helmet and dusting off your gumshield, or simply celebrating your love of the legendary, culture-defining television show, Gladiators Experience is an unmissable opportunity to live out your Gladiator dreams!

description:
Step into the Arena!
For the first time ever, GladFans across the UK will be able to put their speed, strength and skills to the ultimate test, as the iconic television show explodes into action with Gladiators Experience!
Do you have the nerve to traverse the Hang Tough course? Could you be the last person standing in an epic bout of Duel? Would staring up at The Wall inspire you to scale new heights? Will you be swinging to victory at the end of the legendary Eliminator? Taking place at the Birmingham NEC from May 2026, aspiring Contenders can at long last test their mettle in their favourite events!
And the action doesn’t end there! Away from the Arena, Gladiators Experience boasts even more fun, family-friendly attractions. There’s The Vault, which delivers an unmissable look behind the scenes of the nation’s favourite TV show. The Gladiator Training Facility, meanwhile, will sharpen the skillset needed to be a true Gladiator, and a huge Superstore will be the only place to purchase exclusive merchandise. Plus, with many other surprises along the way, Gladiators Experience is a spectacle like no other.
So whether you’re strapping on your helmet and dusting off your gumshield, or simply celebrating your love of the legendary, culture-defining television show, Gladiators Experience is an unmissable opportunity to live out your Gladiator dreams!

description:
Step into the Arena!
For the first time ever, GladFans across the UK will be able to put their speed, strength and skills to the ultimate test, as the iconic television show explodes into action with Gladiators Experience!
Do you have the nerve to traverse the Hang Tough course? Could you be the last person standing in an epic bout of Duel? Would staring up at The Wall inspire you to scale new heights? Will you be swinging to victory at the end of the legendary Eliminator? Taking place at the Birmingham NEC from May 2026, aspiring Contenders can at long last test their mettle in their favourite events!
And the action doesn’t end there! Away from the Arena, Gladiators Experience boasts even more fun, family-friendly attractions. There’s The Vault, which delivers an unmissable look behind the scenes of the nation’s favourite TV show. The Gladiator Training Facility, meanwhile, will sharpen the skillset needed to be a true Gladiator, and a huge Superstore will be the only place to purchase exclusive merchandise. Plus, with many other surprises along the way, Gladiators Experience is a spectacle like no other.
So whether you’re strapping on your helmet and dusting off your gumshield, or simply celebrating your love of the legendary, culture-defining television show, Gladiators Experience is an unmissable opportunity to live out your Gladiator dreams!

description:
Step into the Arena!
For the first time ever, GladFans across the UK will be able to put their speed, strength and skills to the ultimate test, as the iconic television show explodes into action with Gladiators Experience!
Do you have the nerve to traverse the Hang Tough course? Could you be the last person standing in an epic bout of Duel? Would staring up at The Wall inspire you to scale new heights? Will you be swinging to victory at the end of the legendary Eliminator? Taking place at the Birmingham NEC from May 2026, aspiring Contenders can at long last test their mettle in their favourite events!
And the action doesn’t end there! Away from the Arena, Gladiators Experience boasts even more fun, family-friendly attractions. There’s The Vault, which delivers an unmissable look behind the scenes of the nation’s favourite TV show. The Gladiator Training Facility, meanwhile, will sharpen the skillset needed to be a true Gladiator, and a huge Superstore will be the only place to purchase exclusive merchandise. Plus, with many other surprises along the way, Gladiators Experience is a spectacle like no other.
So whether you’re strapping on your helmet and dusting off your gumshield, or simply celebrating your love of the legendary, culture-defining television show, Gladiators Experience is an unmissable opportunity to live out your Gladiator dreams!

description:
Step into the Arena!
For the first time ever, GladFans across the UK will be able to put their speed, strength and skills to the ultimate test, as the iconic television show explodes into action with Gladiators Experience!
Do you have the nerve to traverse the Hang Tough course? Could you be the last person standing in an epic bout of Duel? Would staring up at The Wall inspire you to scale new heights? Will you be swinging to victory at the end of the legendary Eliminator? Taking place at the Birmingham NEC from May 2026, aspiring Contenders can at long last test their mettle in their favourite events!
And the action doesn’t end there! Away from the Arena, Gladiators Experience boasts even more fun, family-friendly attractions. There’s The Vault, which delivers an unmissable look behind the scenes of the nation’s favourite TV show. The Gladiator Training Facility, meanwhile, will sharpen the skillset needed to be a true Gladiator, and a huge Superstore will be the only place to purchase exclusive merchandise. Plus, with many other surprises along the way, Gladiators Experience is a spectacle like no other.
So whether you’re strapping on your helmet and dusting off your gumshield, or simply celebrating your love of the legendary, culture-defining television show, Gladiators Experience is an unmissable opportunity to live out your Gladiator dreams!

Voted one of the “Hottest Bass Players in the World” by Bass Player magazine, Shez Raja is a boundary-pushing bassist and electrifying performer who has drawn comparisons to Jaco Pastorius. Playing a fusion of Indo-jazz, funk and groove, he has collaborated with icons including Mike Stern, Randy Brecker, Wayne Krantz and Trilok Gurtu.
Joining Shez is visionary guitarist Guthrie Govan, famed for his virtuosic technique and work with Hans Zimmer. Guthrie has been voted “Guitarist of the Year” by Guitarist magazine, graced the covers of Guitar Player and Guitar World and has earned his place as guitar royalty on the world stage.
Now touring acclaimed new album Spellbound – featuring drum titan Dennis Chambers – Shez, Guthrie and Tony bring this exciting music to the stage.
Expect a spellbinding journey through euphoric jazz, thundering funk, cosmic improvisation and intoxicating grooves.

description:
Step into the Arena!
For the first time ever, GladFans across the UK will be able to put their speed, strength and skills to the ultimate test, as the iconic television show explodes into action with Gladiators Experience!
Do you have the nerve to traverse the Hang Tough course? Could you be the last person standing in an epic bout of Duel? Would staring up at The Wall inspire you to scale new heights? Will you be swinging to victory at the end of the legendary Eliminator? Taking place at the Birmingham NEC from May 2026, aspiring Contenders can at long last test their mettle in their favourite events!
And the action doesn’t end there! Away from the Arena, Gladiators Experience boasts even more fun, family-friendly attractions. There’s The Vault, which delivers an unmissable look behind the scenes of the nation’s favourite TV show. The Gladiator Training Facility, meanwhile, will sharpen the skillset needed to be a true Gladiator, and a huge Superstore will be the only place to purchase exclusive merchandise. Plus, with many other surprises along the way, Gladiators Experience is a spectacle like no other.
So whether you’re strapping on your helmet and dusting off your gumshield, or simply celebrating your love of the legendary, culture-defining television show, Gladiators Experience is an unmissable opportunity to live out your Gladiator dreams!

description:
One of the most outstanding instrumentalists in rock over the past 40 years, Texas guitarist Eric Johnson was
already a legend before he recorded his first album. By the early 1980s, many celebrated guitarists were singing
the praises of this skinny kid from Austin with the mind-melting chops. Comparisons were made to such guitar
heroes as Jeff Beck and Jimi Hendrix and when he joined the ‘70s Austin fusion band Electromagnets they were
being hailed as “the Mahavishnu Orchestra of Texas”. With the release of his highly-anticipated 1986 solo debut
album Tones, the underground guitar legend finally emerged onto the scene fully-formed. It landed him on the
cover of Guitar Player magazine, which hailed the album as a “majestic debut”, and earned him his first Grammy
nomination for the song “Zap”. With the release of his follow up album, 1990’s platinum-selling Ah Via Musicom,
which contained the Grammy Award winning song “Cliffs of Dover”, Eric Johnson became a bona fide international
guitar phenomenon.

The New Age Music Guide once opined that “Eric Johnson plays guitar the way Michelangelo painted ceilings:
with a colorful vibrancy that’s more real than life” while Rolling Stone included him in their list of the 100 Greatest
Guitarists of the 21st century. A dynamic singer as well as an incredibly gifted guitarist, a pianist and a prolific
songwriter, Eric has been featured on the cover of countless guitar magazines around the world while also racking
up critical accolades along the way.

Since 1986 Eric has released seventeen albums, in addition to albums with other artists such as Eclectic with
jazz guitarist Mike Stern, and the platinum-selling G3 Live with Joe Satriani and Steve Vai. Eric has received eight
Grammy nominations along with numerous other recognitions, awards and wins in various polls and magazines.
Among Johnson’s many accolades are a GRAMMY award in 1992 for “Cliffs of Dover” as Best Rock Instrumental
Performance, lifetime induction into the Guitar Player Gallery of Greats, and his listing among the “100 Greatest
Guitarists of the 20th Century” by Musician magazine. In his hometown of Austin Texas, a city full of guitarists, the
readers of the Austin Chronicle voted Eric Johnson the city’s “Best Electric Guitarist” and “Best Acoustic Guitarist”
in their yearly poll year after year. They also named him “Electric Guitarist of the Decade” and one of the top five
“Musicians of the Decade”. In February 2024 Eric was honored with induction into the Texas Heritage Songwriters
Association Hall of Fame.

2023 found Eric on his ‘Treasure Tour’, 67 US dates that were split between a Spring and a Fall tour. In January
and February 2024 Eric joined the ‘G3 Reunion Tour’ with Joe Satriani and Steve Vai, and the resulting new live
album from the tour will be released in January 2025. In August 2024 he heads out for a run of dates in the north
and northeast including the Backroads Blues Festival in New York. In September and October 2024 Eric was
a featured performer on the ‘Experience Hendrix 2024 Tour’, crossing the country from Washington state to
Florida, and then rejoined in March and April 2025 for the ‘Experience Hendrix 2025 Tour’ throughout the east and
northeast USA and Canada.

Over the course of more than four decades, Eric Johnson has been traveling on a prolific odyssey. Along the way,
his creations have cross-pollinated the various musical genres which include rock, blues, jazz, fusion, soul, folk,
new-age, classical, and even country. Inevitably EJ says it best himself in sharing that regardless of the genre “It
really boils down to the music and the song at the end of the day”, he explains. “The most important thing for me is
to grow musically and make a more expansive and meaningful artistic statement with every new project”.

description:
Step into the Arena!
For the first time ever, GladFans across the UK will be able to put their speed, strength and skills to the ultimate test, as the iconic television show explodes into action with Gladiators Experience!
Do you have the nerve to traverse the Hang Tough course? Could you be the last person standing in an epic bout of Duel? Would staring up at The Wall inspire you to scale new heights? Will you be swinging to victory at the end of the legendary Eliminator? Taking place at the Birmingham NEC from May 2026, aspiring Contenders can at long last test their mettle in their favourite events!
And the action doesn’t end there! Away from the Arena, Gladiators Experience boasts even more fun, family-friendly attractions. There’s The Vault, which delivers an unmissable look behind the scenes of the nation’s favourite TV show. The Gladiator Training Facility, meanwhile, will sharpen the skillset needed to be a true Gladiator, and a huge Superstore will be the only place to purchase exclusive merchandise. Plus, with many other surprises along the way, Gladiators Experience is a spectacle like no other.
So whether you’re strapping on your helmet and dusting off your gumshield, or simply celebrating your love of the legendary, culture-defining television show, Gladiators Experience is an unmissable opportunity to live out your Gladiator dreams!

description:
Step into the Arena!
For the first time ever, GladFans across the UK will be able to put their speed, strength and skills to the ultimate test, as the iconic television show explodes into action with Gladiators Experience!
Do you have the nerve to traverse the Hang Tough course? Could you be the last person standing in an epic bout of Duel? Would staring up at The Wall inspire you to scale new heights? Will you be swinging to victory at the end of the legendary Eliminator? Taking place at the Birmingham NEC from May 2026, aspiring Contenders can at long last test their mettle in their favourite events!
And the action doesn’t end there! Away from the Arena, Gladiators Experience boasts even more fun, family-friendly attractions. There’s The Vault, which delivers an unmissable look behind the scenes of the nation’s favourite TV show. The Gladiator Training Facility, meanwhile, will sharpen the skillset needed to be a true Gladiator, and a huge Superstore will be the only place to purchase exclusive merchandise. Plus, with many other surprises along the way, Gladiators Experience is a spectacle like no other.
So whether you’re strapping on your helmet and dusting off your gumshield, or simply celebrating your love of the legendary, culture-defining television show, Gladiators Experience is an unmissable opportunity to live out your Gladiator dreams!

description:
Step into the Arena!
For the first time ever, GladFans across the UK will be able to put their speed, strength and skills to the ultimate test, as the iconic television show explodes into action with Gladiators Experience!
Do you have the nerve to traverse the Hang Tough course? Could you be the last person standing in an epic bout of Duel? Would staring up at The Wall inspire you to scale new heights? Will you be swinging to victory at the end of the legendary Eliminator? Taking place at the Birmingham NEC from May 2026, aspiring Contenders can at long last test their mettle in their favourite events!
And the action doesn’t end there! Away from the Arena, Gladiators Experience boasts even more fun, family-friendly attractions. There’s The Vault, which delivers an unmissable look behind the scenes of the nation’s favourite TV show. The Gladiator Training Facility, meanwhile, will sharpen the skillset needed to be a true Gladiator, and a huge Superstore will be the only place to purchase exclusive merchandise. Plus, with many other surprises along the way, Gladiators Experience is a spectacle like no other.
So whether you’re strapping on your helmet and dusting off your gumshield, or simply celebrating your love of the legendary, culture-defining television show, Gladiators Experience is an unmissable opportunity to live out your Gladiator dreams!

description:
An Evening of… Gregory Isaacs with Terence Wallen 
Terence Wallen is a British-born Reggae sensation of Jamaican heritage, hailed across music circles for his extraordinary and captivating embodiment of the legendary Gregory Isaacs affectionately known as “The Cool Ruler”.
With a striking resemblance, effortless style, and magnetic charisma, Wallen doesn’t just perform Isaacs’ music he channels his spirit on classics such as “Slave Master”, “Cool Down the Pace”, “Number One” and of course “Night Nurse”.

Audiences around the globe consistently leave his shows convinced they’ve witnessed the reggae icon in all his glory.
Support for this special show comes from Major Popular.

Standing Tickets: £17
Dinner & Show Ticket: £70 Balcony Dining or £60 non-balcony (both include a Three Course Meal & ticket) – please click on the ‘make a booking enquiry‘ button at the bottom.

Doors open at 6pm
The Jam House, Birmingham – Where music entertainment lives since 1999…  Nestled in the heart of Birmingham’s historic Jewellery Quarter, The Jam House is a renowned live music venue set within a beautiful Georgian building overlooking the scenic St Paul’s Square. This award-winning destination combines live entertainment, delicious food, and unforgettable nights out, making it a must-visit spot for locals and tourists alike.

Getting Here:🚗 Free Parking: Available around St Paul’s Square after 6 PM.🚆 Nearest Train Station: Snow Hill Station – just a short walk away.🚋 Nearest Tram Stop: St Paul’s – conveniently located nearby

description:
Step into the Arena!
For the first time ever, GladFans across the UK will be able to put their speed, strength and skills to the ultimate test, as the iconic television show explodes into action with Gladiators Experience!
Do you have the nerve to traverse the Hang Tough course? Could you be the last person standing in an epic bout of Duel? Would staring up at The Wall inspire you to scale new heights? Will you be swinging to victory at the end of the legendary Eliminator? Taking place at the Birmingham NEC from May 2026, aspiring Contenders can at long last test their mettle in their favourite events!
And the action doesn’t end there! Away from the Arena, Gladiators Experience boasts even more fun, family-friendly attractions. There’s The Vault, which delivers an unmissable look behind the scenes of the nation’s favourite TV show. The Gladiator Training Facility, meanwhile, will sharpen the skillset needed to be a true Gladiator, and a huge Superstore will be the only place to purchase exclusive merchandise. Plus, with many other surprises along the way, Gladiators Experience is a spectacle like no other.
So whether you’re strapping on your helmet and dusting off your gumshield, or simply celebrating your love of the legendary, culture-defining television show, Gladiators Experience is an unmissable opportunity to live out your Gladiator dreams!

description:
Step into the Arena!
For the first time ever, GladFans across the UK will be able to put their speed, strength and skills to the ultimate test, as the iconic television show explodes into action with Gladiators Experience!
Do you have the nerve to traverse the Hang Tough course? Could you be the last person standing in an epic bout of Duel? Would staring up at The Wall inspire you to scale new heights? Will you be swinging to victory at the end of the legendary Eliminator? Taking place at the Birmingham NEC from May 2026, aspiring Contenders can at long last test their mettle in their favourite events!
And the action doesn’t end there! Away from the Arena, Gladiators Experience boasts even more fun, family-friendly attractions. There’s The Vault, which delivers an unmissable look behind the scenes of the nation’s favourite TV show. The Gladiator Training Facility, meanwhile, will sharpen the skillset needed to be a true Gladiator, and a huge Superstore will be the only place to purchase exclusive merchandise. Plus, with many other surprises along the way, Gladiators Experience is a spectacle like no other.
So whether you’re strapping on your helmet and dusting off your gumshield, or simply celebrating your love of the legendary, culture-defining television show, Gladiators Experience is an unmissable opportunity to live out your Gladiator dreams!

description:
Step into the Arena!
For the first time ever, GladFans across the UK will be able to put their speed, strength and skills to the ultimate test, as the iconic television show explodes into action with Gladiators Experience!
Do you have the nerve to traverse the Hang Tough course? Could you be the last person standing in an epic bout of Duel? Would staring up at The Wall inspire you to scale new heights? Will you be swinging to victory at the end of the legendary Eliminator? Taking place at the Birmingham NEC from May 2026, aspiring Contenders can at long last test their mettle in their favourite events!
And the action doesn’t end there! Away from the Arena, Gladiators Experience boasts even more fun, family-friendly attractions. There’s The Vault, which delivers an unmissable look behind the scenes of the nation’s favourite TV show. The Gladiator Training Facility, meanwhile, will sharpen the skillset needed to be a true Gladiator, and a huge Superstore will be the only place to purchase exclusive merchandise. Plus, with many other surprises along the way, Gladiators Experience is a spectacle like no other.
So whether you’re strapping on your helmet and dusting off your gumshield, or simply celebrating your love of the legendary, culture-defining television show, Gladiators Experience is an unmissable opportunity to live out your Gladiator dreams!

description:
Step into the Arena!
For the first time ever, GladFans across the UK will be able to put their speed, strength and skills to the ultimate test, as the iconic television show explodes into action with Gladiators Experience!
Do you have the nerve to traverse the Hang Tough course? Could you be the last person standing in an epic bout of Duel? Would staring up at The Wall inspire you to scale new heights? Will you be swinging to victory at the end of the legendary Eliminator? Taking place at the Birmingham NEC from May 2026, aspiring Contenders can at long last test their mettle in their favourite events!
And the action doesn’t end there! Away from the Arena, Gladiators Experience boasts even more fun, family-friendly attractions. There’s The Vault, which delivers an unmissable look behind the scenes of the nation’s favourite TV show. The Gladiator Training Facility, meanwhile, will sharpen the skillset needed to be a true Gladiator, and a huge Superstore will be the only place to purchase exclusive merchandise. Plus, with many other surprises along the way, Gladiators Experience is a spectacle like no other.
So whether you’re strapping on your helmet and dusting off your gumshield, or simply celebrating your love of the legendary, culture-defining television show, Gladiators Experience is an unmissable opportunity to live out your Gladiator dreams!

description:
Step into the Arena!
For the first time ever, GladFans across the UK will be able to put their speed, strength and skills to the ultimate test, as the iconic television show explodes into action with Gladiators Experience!
Do you have the nerve to traverse the Hang Tough course? Could you be the last person standing in an epic bout of Duel? Would staring up at The Wall inspire you to scale new heights? Will you be swinging to victory at the end of the legendary Eliminator? Taking place at the Birmingham NEC from May 2026, aspiring Contenders can at long last test their mettle in their favourite events!
And the action doesn’t end there! Away from the Arena, Gladiators Experience boasts even more fun, family-friendly attractions. There’s The Vault, which delivers an unmissable look behind the scenes of the nation’s favourite TV show. The Gladiator Training Facility, meanwhile, will sharpen the skillset needed to be a true Gladiator, and a huge Superstore will be the only place to purchase exclusive merchandise. Plus, with many other surprises along the way, Gladiators Experience is a spectacle like no other.
So whether you’re strapping on your helmet and dusting off your gumshield, or simply celebrating your love of the legendary, culture-defining television show, Gladiators Experience is an unmissable opportunity to live out your Gladiator dreams!

description:
A celebrated veteran of the British music scene, Andy Bennett first made his mark as part of the band Sargent, earning early acclaim with singles such as "The Place I'm In" and "Takin Me High."

A name change to The Elements soon followed, along with a Top 10 hit and growing national attention. Their rising profile caught the eye of indie rock legends Ocean Colour Scene, who invited The Elements to join them as a support act on tour, a partnership that would shape the next chapter of Andy's career.

After leaving The Elements, Andy went on to join Ocean Colour Scene themselves, contributing his distinctive sound and songwriting to the band's next eight studio albums. Years of touring the world and performing to thousands cemented his reputation as a dynamic and accomplished musician.

Now, Andy Bennett returns to his roots with a live show that celebrates his remarkable journey through British indie and rock.

Expect a set packed with Ocean Colour Scene classics, fan favourites from The Elements and Sargent, plus brand-new material, all delivered with the passion, musicianship, and authenticity that have defined Andy's career.
Book your tickets now and experience Andy Bennett live in an unforgettable night of music spanning decades of iconic British sound.

description:
Step into the Arena!
For the first time ever, GladFans across the UK will be able to put their speed, strength and skills to the ultimate test, as the iconic television show explodes into action with Gladiators Experience!
Do you have the nerve to traverse the Hang Tough course? Could you be the last person standing in an epic bout of Duel? Would staring up at The Wall inspire you to scale new heights? Will you be swinging to victory at the end of the legendary Eliminator? Taking place at the Birmingham NEC from May 2026, aspiring Contenders can at long last test their mettle in their favourite events!
And the action doesn’t end there! Away from the Arena, Gladiators Experience boasts even more fun, family-friendly attractions. There’s The Vault, which delivers an unmissable look behind the scenes of the nation’s favourite TV show. The Gladiator Training Facility, meanwhile, will sharpen the skillset needed to be a true Gladiator, and a huge Superstore will be the only place to purchase exclusive merchandise. Plus, with many other surprises along the way, Gladiators Experience is a spectacle like no other.
So whether you’re strapping on your helmet and dusting off your gumshield, or simply celebrating your love of the legendary, culture-defining television show, Gladiators Experience is an unmissable opportunity to live out your Gladiator dreams!

description:
Step into the Arena!
For the first time ever, GladFans across the UK will be able to put their speed, strength and skills to the ultimate test, as the iconic television show explodes into action with Gladiators Experience!
Do you have the nerve to traverse the Hang Tough course? Could you be the last person standing in an epic bout of Duel? Would staring up at The Wall inspire you to scale new heights? Will you be swinging to victory at the end of the legendary Eliminator? Taking place at the Birmingham NEC from May 2026, aspiring Contenders can at long last test their mettle in their favourite events!
And the action doesn’t end there! Away from the Arena, Gladiators Experience boasts even more fun, family-friendly attractions. There’s The Vault, which delivers an unmissable look behind the scenes of the nation’s favourite TV show. The Gladiator Training Facility, meanwhile, will sharpen the skillset needed to be a true Gladiator, and a huge Superstore will be the only place to purchase exclusive merchandise. Plus, with many other surprises along the way, Gladiators Experience is a spectacle like no other.
So whether you’re strapping on your helmet and dusting off your gumshield, or simply celebrating your love of the legendary, culture-defining television show, Gladiators Experience is an unmissable opportunity to live out your Gladiator dreams!

description:
Step into the Arena!
For the first time ever, GladFans across the UK will be able to put their speed, strength and skills to the ultimate test, as the iconic television show explodes into action with Gladiators Experience!
Do you have the nerve to traverse the Hang Tough course? Could you be the last person standing in an epic bout of Duel? Would staring up at The Wall inspire you to scale new heights? Will you be swinging to victory at the end of the legendary Eliminator? Taking place at the Birmingham NEC from May 2026, aspiring Contenders can at long last test their mettle in their favourite events!
And the action doesn’t end there! Away from the Arena, Gladiators Experience boasts even more fun, family-friendly attractions. There’s The Vault, which delivers an unmissable look behind the scenes of the nation’s favourite TV show. The Gladiator Training Facility, meanwhile, will sharpen the skillset needed to be a true Gladiator, and a huge Superstore will be the only place to purchase exclusive merchandise. Plus, with many other surprises along the way, Gladiators Experience is a spectacle like no other.
So whether you’re strapping on your helmet and dusting off your gumshield, or simply celebrating your love of the legendary, culture-defining television show, Gladiators Experience is an unmissable opportunity to live out your Gladiator dreams!

description:
Step into the Arena!
For the first time ever, GladFans across the UK will be able to put their speed, strength and skills to the ultimate test, as the iconic television show explodes into action with Gladiators Experience!
Do you have the nerve to traverse the Hang Tough course? Could you be the last person standing in an epic bout of Duel? Would staring up at The Wall inspire you to scale new heights? Will you be swinging to victory at the end of the legendary Eliminator? Taking place at the Birmingham NEC from May 2026, aspiring Contenders can at long last test their mettle in their favourite events!
And the action doesn’t end there! Away from the Arena, Gladiators Experience boasts even more fun, family-friendly attractions. There’s The Vault, which delivers an unmissable look behind the scenes of the nation’s favourite TV show. The Gladiator Training Facility, meanwhile, will sharpen the skillset needed to be a true Gladiator, and a huge Superstore will be the only place to purchase exclusive merchandise. Plus, with many other surprises along the way, Gladiators Experience is a spectacle like no other.
So whether you’re strapping on your helmet and dusting off your gumshield, or simply celebrating your love of the legendary, culture-defining television show, Gladiators Experience is an unmissable opportunity to live out your Gladiator dreams!

description:
After three previous sold out Birmingham events and numerous indie events in 17 other cities, The UK's biggest indie party is coming back Birmingham this Summer for another Afternoon of Indie at O'Neills, Broad Street

Old School Indie - The indie night for the over 30s are once again joining forces with Feeling Gloomy & Age Against The Machine to bring you a special 3pm-7pm Afternoon of Indie.

Feeling Gloomy & Old School Indie DJs will be playing a mix of indie classics from across the decades so whether you were an 70s punk, 80s new waver, 90s britpopper or early 00s poser they'll be something for everyone.

The party will finish at 7pm so you can head down the pub to continue your night our or you could just go home and watch some Saturday night TV with a take away

There is a strict door policy of no under 30s, so please bring ID as you will be asked to show it upon entry

What to expect: The best in indie from: Bowie, Pulp, Clash, Jam, Cure, Joy Division, Stone Roses, Smiths, New Order, Strokes, Supergrass, Kinks, Franz Ferdinand, Nirvana, Ash, Rolling Stones, Who, Primal Scream, Killers, Sultans of Ping, Buzzcocks, Ramones, Specials, Blondie, Hole, Madness, La's, Weezer, Cardigans, Housemartins, Coral, Undertones, Inspiral Carpets, Bloc Party, Beatles, Yeah Yeah Yeahs, Radiohead, Suede, Echo and The Bunnymen, Pixies, Ocean Colour Scene plus the odd bit of rock n roll, soul, northern soul and ska!

description:
Step into the Arena!
For the first time ever, GladFans across the UK will be able to put their speed, strength and skills to the ultimate test, as the iconic television show explodes into action with Gladiators Experience!
Do you have the nerve to traverse the Hang Tough course? Could you be the last person standing in an epic bout of Duel? Would staring up at The Wall inspire you to scale new heights? Will you be swinging to victory at the end of the legendary Eliminator? Taking place at the Birmingham NEC from May 2026, aspiring Contenders can at long last test their mettle in their favourite events!
And the action doesn’t end there! Away from the Arena, Gladiators Experience boasts even more fun, family-friendly attractions. There’s The Vault, which delivers an unmissable look behind the scenes of the nation’s favourite TV show. The Gladiator Training Facility, meanwhile, will sharpen the skillset needed to be a true Gladiator, and a huge Superstore will be the only place to purchase exclusive merchandise. Plus, with many other surprises along the way, Gladiators Experience is a spectacle like no other.
So whether you’re strapping on your helmet and dusting off your gumshield, or simply celebrating your love of the legendary, culture-defining television show, Gladiators Experience is an unmissable opportunity to live out your Gladiator dreams!

description:
Step into the Arena!
For the first time ever, GladFans across the UK will be able to put their speed, strength and skills to the ultimate test, as the iconic television show explodes into action with Gladiators Experience!
Do you have the nerve to traverse the Hang Tough course? Could you be the last person standing in an epic bout of Duel? Would staring up at The Wall inspire you to scale new heights? Will you be swinging to victory at the end of the legendary Eliminator? Taking place at the Birmingham NEC from May 2026, aspiring Contenders can at long last test their mettle in their favourite events!
And the action doesn’t end there! Away from the Arena, Gladiators Experience boasts even more fun, family-friendly attractions. There’s The Vault, which delivers an unmissable look behind the scenes of the nation’s favourite TV show. The Gladiator Training Facility, meanwhile, will sharpen the skillset needed to be a true Gladiator, and a huge Superstore will be the only place to purchase exclusive merchandise. Plus, with many other surprises along the way, Gladiators Experience is a spectacle like no other.
So whether you’re strapping on your helmet and dusting off your gumshield, or simply celebrating your love of the legendary, culture-defining television show, Gladiators Experience is an unmissable opportunity to live out your Gladiator dreams!
